meta.name: add-github
meta.description: Add GitHub channel integration via Chat SDK. PR and issue comment threads as conversations.

copy.tagline: 将 PR 和 Issue 评论变为聊天讨论
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果正在开发聊天应用并想让团队在会话中讨论代码。
copy.tagline_en: Turn GitHub PR and issue discussions into chat conversations.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building a chat app and want to sync GitHub discussions.

howto.what: 给项目接上 GitHub 渠道:Claude 会参与 PR 和 issue 的评论线程,被 @ 到后回复该线程里的后续评论。需要先建一个专用 GitHub 机器人账号,并配置令牌和仓库 webhook。
howto.when: 当有人在 PR 或 issue 评论里 @ 到机器人账号时接管;首次被提及后该线程被订阅,之后的评论都会回应。前提是仓库 webhook 已配置好。

say.text: 帮我把 GitHub 渠道接进来,机器人账号已经建好了
say.note: 会从 channels 分支复制适配器、注册并安装依赖

say.text: 这是私有仓库,unknown_sender_policy 用 public
say.note: 按私有仓库的方式接线

howto.what_en: Adds a GitHub channel: Claude takes part in PR and issue comment threads, replying once @-mentioned and then following that thread. A dedicated GitHub bot account, a fine-grained PAT, and repo webhooks are needed.
howto.when_en: Takes over when someone @-mentions the bot account in a PR or issue comment; after the first mention the thread is subscribed and later comments are answered too. Repo webhooks must be set up first.

say_en.text: Add the GitHub channel for me, the bot account is ready
say_en.note: Copies the adapter, registers it, installs the package

say_en.text: This is a private repo, use unknown_sender_policy public
say_en.note: Wires the channel for a private repo

say_en.text: Wire this repo's PR comment threads to my agent group with per-thread sessions
say_en.note: Creates the messaging group and wiring
